book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.1:
Preparations

Build rotational power and processing in the Overworld. Bring a drill head, controller, remote, two bore stations, Super Glue, a wrench and supplies. Andesite Casing unlocks equipment recipes.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.2:
Drill assembly

Build against the controller panel and power its rear shaft. Glue cutters, frame, chest and destination station together. Place cutters on each working face; changing direction does not rotate the head.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.3:
Drilling

Empty-hand use assembles, pauses or resumes. While paused, use a wrench to change direction; sneak-use it to place the head. Bind a remote to the controller, then use it to toggle or sneak-use to redirect.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.4:
Into the mantle

Drill down to Y=-58 to enter the mantle. Resume down into the ceiling, then excavate sideways to form a base. Keep the Overworld controller powered. The mantle ceiling occupies Y=200–255.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.5:
Bore stations

Bind both stations with the remote. Keep the first within 32 blocks of its controller; carry the second on the head. Excavate a dry, two-block exit with solid footing. Pause and place the head to connect.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.6:
The dry dock

Excavate dry rooms and dock space. Use a charged respawn anchor in the mantle; beds explode.

Build a dry, sealed hull. Matching stacked hatches form a walkable entrance.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.7:
Heat and Power

Glue the hull and machinery, then assemble with Aeronautics. Heat engines supply 32 RPM in mantle lava and share the vessel's cabin coolant. Refill a regulator to restart after coolant loss.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.8:
Thrust and turning

Immersed thrusters move the probe; reverse rotation to back up. Create Clutches stop shafts and Gearshifts reverse them. Control left and right drives separately to turn. Redstone Links enable cabin controls.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.9:
Trim and sealing

32 RPM holds depth. Sneak empty-hand on ballast to cycle RPM control, ascend and descend; set both alike. Each supports 128 mass.

Face regulators inward at 16+ RPM and seal the cabin.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.10:
Scanning and berth

Power the sounder at 16+ RPM for mineral scans and forward clearance. Empty-hand use lists targets and faults. It records its berth on placement; sneak-use in a dry dock to reset return distance and bearing.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.11:
Sampling and cargo

The sampler mines deposits up to 4 blocks ahead. Clear obstructions and hold position. Its nine-slot hold pauses when full; empty-hand use unloads a stack. Seek harmonic ore near Y=164–196 and smelt the raw ore.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.12:
Cooling

Use cells on a regulator: ordinary 120 units, stabilized 240, capacity 600. Cabin cooling uses 1 unit/s; each heat engine adds 0.1 unit/s.

Refill even with power off. Bring water buckets from the Overworld.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.13:
Damage control

Heat warns at 60%%. Ten seconds at full heat damages a drive and hull; continued heat opens a breach. Locate faults with the sounder and cool down. Repair kits restore drives and cracked plates at 70%% heat or below.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.14:
Patch and Return

Seal breaches with emergency plates. Refill coolant after power loss. Stored coolant enables a 5s emergency spray.

Follow the home bearing. Drain the dock before opening.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.15:
Outside the hull

Fire resistance does not stop mantle heat exposure: a warning follows three seconds and damage follows five. Keep the cabin sealed and cooled. Leave the probe in dry spaces; maintain a stocked recovery base.
Obtain a drill controller and prepare to reach the mantle.

advancement.aeronautics_innerworld.probe: Obtain an echo sounder for lava-sea exploration.
advancement.aeronautics_innerworld.sampl: Recover raw harmonic ore for processing at base.
advancement.aeronautics_innerworld.cryst: Process harmonic ore into crystals for the next expedition.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.sonar_no_: No relay echo nearby; continue surveying.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.relay.1:
Relay log

The lower intake remains open. Reach the raised gallery before leaving protective equipment. The inner bulkhead leads to the archive. Emergency coolant and alloy stock are kept behind it.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.relay.2:
Final transmission

The heat-regulation network has stopped answering. Core Wardens sealed the deeper shafts. Recover survey records from the relay chain. A working regulator may still open a route below.
advancement.aeronautics_innerworld.relay: Recover relic alloy from a mantle survey relay.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.cannon_st: Pressure cannon: %s rounds · %s RPM; fires while powered.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.hull_unde: Hull impact: check local damage and equipment faults.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.16:
Pressure cannon

Mount the cannon on the probe and supply 16+ RPM. Use bolts on it to load its 64-round magazine. A Create Clutch controls fire. Aim the front face at the target. Shooting adds heat; watch coolant.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.17:
Heatweave gear

Stalker scales make a mask and jacket. Heat limits: mask 15 s, jacket 15 s, both 25 s. A full set also resists fire below its heat limit. Cool down in a dry space; the suit is for brief work.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.grazer_wa: The grazer is becoming agitated; give it space.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.grazer_sa: Gentle sampling recovers in about %s seconds.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.sampler_g: The grazer is accumulating minerals; return later.
Gentle sampling in progress; withdraw after collection.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.18:
Gentle harvesting

Grazers tolerate brief visits. A sampler can recover one raw harmonic mineral per minute without harm. Withdraw after sampling; repeated intrusion or attacks provoke them. Use heated mixing to recast relic alloy.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.deep_works.1:
Deep Isolation Order

Pressure matrices remain in the archive. Lava flooded the works. Crews withdrew to the side galleries.

Rebuild a bore coupler with a matrix, relic alloy, crystals and precision mechanisms.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.deep_works.2:
The Core Warden enforces isolation.

Glue a coupler to a drill head. Bore through the mantle floor, carrying a station. Leave its partner above.

Build a core camp, then restore the maintenance nodes on foot.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.19:
Deep Works

Search the lower lava sea. Sounders report sites within 128 blocks. Use dry side galleries; avoid magma cubes.

Recover matrices. Use relic alloy, crystals and precision mechanisms to build a bore coupler.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.20:
Core Camp

Set a mantle controller. Glue a coupler and station to its head. Drill to Y=2. Descend, pause and place near the floor. Keep the exit dry.

Link a supply station. Bring a bed, food and gear.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.core_batt: The Warden is active. Regroup and return to continue the fight.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.core_rema: The circuit is quiet. Sneak-use this console empty-handed with four harmonic crystals in your pack for a rematch.
A rematch requires four harmonic crystals in your pack.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.core_aren: Clear the center of the arena before starting.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.core_batt: Isolation lifted. The Warden is active. Use arena coolant valves to expose its core!
message.aeronautics_innerworld.core_surv: Use the surveyor in the core.
No maintenance signal found. Travel farther and try again.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.warden_at: Impact locked: leave the marked circle!
Core overload: retreat beyond the warning ring!
message.aeronautics_innerworld.core_endi: The Warden halts. The runaway extraction circuit shuts down, and the anomaly settles. Your expedition is complete. Your bases and routes remain open for further exploration.
advancement.aeronautics_innerworld.core_: Defeat the Core Warden and halt the runaway heat circuit.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.core.1:
Maintenance

Restore 3 numbered nodes. Use a surveyor on the console to inspect circuits; use it empty-handed to start the Warden.

Copper pillars mark the entrance. Walls can be mined.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.core.2:
Cooling

Arena levers expose the core for 8s; both share a 15s recharge. An enabled lever queues the next vent. Turn it off to cancel.

Watch the boss bar and dodge warnings. The final phase stays exposed.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.21:
Core Labyrinth

Craft a surveyor with a compass, crystal and relic alloy. Use it in the core to find an entrance.

Restore three copper node levers, then use the console by the core gate. It reports inactive nodes.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.22:
Warden

Dodge warning rings. Pull a coolant lever to expose the core for 8s.

After victory, sneak-use the console with four crystals for a rematch.
advancement.aeronautics_innerworld.core_: Reach the core and prepare a camp for the labyrinth.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.23:
Recovery

Make a recovery compass with a compass, two crystals and two relic alloy. Use it on a powered sounder to follow your wreck or its last known position.

Keep a stocked spare probe.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.sonar_rou: This compass has no target in this dimension.
Waypoint cleared; navigating to the home berth.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.24:
Route compasses

Use a plain compass on a powered sounder to save its nearest site, ore or position. Use a saved compass to reload it.

Sneak empty-hand to cancel; the berth stays recorded.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.25:
Dry Dock

Load coolant, assemble, close hatches, then flood the dock. Confirm power and cabin sealing before departure.

Return, close the gates and drain before opening.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.26:
Dock cargo

Dry the bay. Face two powered Aeronautics connectors across two air blocks. Hoppers unload samples and load supplies in both directions.

Retract a connector before launch.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.multi_axis_: Glue to a drill frame. Cuts the face in the direction of travel, for vertical boring or horizontal excavation.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.drill_contr: Build the glued drill head against the _front panel_. Supply rotation from the _back_. The controller stays at the drilling site.
Assemble, start or pause the head.
Cycle the travel direction. Sneak-wrench to place the head back in the world.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.bore_statio: Glue one station to the drill head and keep its partner above. Bind both with the _same drilling remote_. Leave solid ground and two dry blocks of clearance at each exit.
Travel with your inventory. Sneak-use to inspect the destination.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.molten_thru: Supply rotation from the _back_. Works when immersed in mantle lava on an assembled probe. Reverse rotation to reverse thrust; vary the two sides to steer.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.mantle_ball: Supply rotation from the _back_. At _32 RPM_, holds depth in mantle lava. Add ballast tanks for larger probes.
Cycle speed control, ascent and descent. Use matching modes on both sides.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.cabin_regul: Point the vent _into a dry, enclosed cabin_. Supply at least _16 RPM_ from the back and close all hatches. Use coolant cells on the regulator to replenish cooling.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.echo_sounde: Supply at least _16 RPM_ from the back. Finds nearby ore and ruins, marks lava creatures and guides the probe home.
Use with a compass or recovery compass
Record or load a route. A recovery compass loads your last death. Sneak-use empty-handed to cancel.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.mantle_samp: Glue onto the probe and power from the _back_. Collects ore, calm grazer samples and loose cargo within _4 blocks_ ahead. Keep moving targets in front of the intake.
Unload one cargo stack. Select an empty hotbar slot before repeating. Sneak-use to inspect cargo.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.pressure_ca: Supply at least _16 RPM_ from the back. Shoots along the barrel; use a clutch to control firing. Shooting generates heat.
Reload up to 64 bolts. Sneak-use empty-handed to unload ammunition.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.pressure_ha: Use empty-handed to open or close. Close before flooding the dock. Adjacent hatches with the same facing open together.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.deep_bore_c: Glue to the _Create drill head_ to bore through the mantle floor into the core. Carry a bore station to establish a supply route.
block.aeronautics_innerworld.emergency_p: Place into a hull breach to restore the enclosure. Cool the cabin, then repair damaged plates and equipment with repair kits.
item.aeronautics_innerworld.coolant_cell: Use on a cabin regulator for _120 units_ of shared cooling. Works with power off. Bring spare cells.
item.aeronautics_innerworld.stabilized_c: Use on a cabin regulator for _240 units_ of shared cooling. Each regulator holds up to 600 units.
item.aeronautics_innerworld.repair_kit.t: Use on a cracked hull plate or faulty drive when cabin heat is _70%% or lower_. Replace missing blocks and patch open breaches first.
item.aeronautics_innerworld.core_surveyo: Use in the _core_ to locate a labyrinth. Use on a _core console_ to inspect node status and cooling without starting combat. Bring food, light and equipment.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.warden_he: Heat leak marked: leave the circle! A coolant valve can extinguish it.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.27:
Heat leaks

From phase two, leave orange rings before blue fire ignites.

Valves extinguish heat. Heatweave gear reduces it; shields and ordinary armor do not.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.sampler_s: Recovering loose cargo; any remainder stays outside when cargo is full.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.28:
Salvage

Power the sampler. Face loose loot within 4 blocks and keep the intake clear.

Empty-hand use unloads one stack. Select another empty slot to repeat. Full cargo leaves the remainder outside.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.sonar_no_: No death location is recorded for rescue navigation.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.29:
First materials

Bring nether bricks, made by smelting netherrack, and nether quartz. Press copper into sheets. Mix quartz and redstone into rose quartz; polish it for electron tubes.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.30:
Engine Upgrade

Hand-crank eight saw/press rounds. Craft the assembly with an iron sheet and blast furnace.

Upgrade the portable engine with 3 copper sheets and a fluid tank.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.31:
Base foundry

Put a blaze burner below a basin and a mixer two blocks above it. Supply at least 32 RPM and fuel the burner. Empty-hand right-click the basin top for alloy.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.32:
Alloy recasting

Mix 1 relic alloy, 2 harmonic crystals, 2 molten scales and 2 iron ingots in a heated basin for 2 alloy. Find the first alloy in ruins; keep one ingot to seed the next batch.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.name: Innerworld Expedition Journal
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.landin: Follow the expedition tree from your first drill to the Core Warden. Open a node for objectives, recipes and related field notes. Green ticks mark completed tasks. Milestone rewards arrive automatically, once per player.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.catego: The main route leads underground. The combat and protection branch helps prepare for longer expeditions.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.refere: Practical notes on construction, piloting, industry, repairs and recovery.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.tree_h: Select a node to read its objective. The branching tree is also available through the advancement button on the landing page. Locked chapters open as the preceding milestone is completed.
Craft a drill controller. Connect a cutting head and storage with Super Glue, then supply rotation. Reward: 10 XP.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.mantle: Enter the mantle through your bore station. Excavate the upper rock layer and leave a dry, supported station exit. Reward: 20 XP.
Obtain an echo sounder and fit it to a sealed, powered probe. Build and operate the probe in the mantle. Reward: 15 XP.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.sample: Bring raw harmonic ore into your inventory after sampling a vein or a calm grazer. Keep the return route and coolant supply ready. Reward: 20 XP.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.crysta: Smelt raw harmonic ore into a crystal. Use the result for stronger supplies and later drilling upgrades. Reward: 25 XP.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.defens: Defeat a lava stalker. A pressure cannon helps keep the fight outside the hull. Reward: 30 XP and 4 cooked beef.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.protec: Obtain a heatweave mask. Pair it with fire resistance for short lava transfers, and return to dry shelter before heat builds up. Reward: 20 XP.
Recover relic alloy from a relay or deep works. Retain some for heated recasting at the base. Reward: 40 XP.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.deep_w: Recover a pressure matrix from the archive of a deep works. Reserve alloy and precision mechanisms for the coupler. Reward: 50 XP and 2 stabilized coolant cells.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.deep_d: Craft a deep bore coupler and glue it onto the Create drill head with a bore station. Leave the probe at your mantle base. Reward: 50 XP.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.core.t: Travel to the core through the drilling connection. Prepare a bed, food, lighting and personal equipment, then use the surveyor to find the maze. Reward: 75 XP.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.victor: Restore three maintenance nodes, activate the console and defeat the Core Warden. Use the cooling valves and heed attack warnings. Reward: 200 XP; the defeated Warden leaves its core.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.tasks.progre: Complete the objective on the left to record this milestone. Rewards arrive automatically and are granted once for this task. Reopening the journal keeps your progress.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.33:
Batch engines

Reserve seven iron sheets and seven blast furnaces. Complete all eight rounds for every workpiece. Keep successes and byproducts; make more assemblies if needed.
book.aeronautics_innerworld.page.34:
Batch handling

Unfinished assemblies do not stack. Load up to five per hopper; collect outputs before refilling. Keep hull supplies in chests and bring plenty of food for cranking.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.heat_engi: No cabin regulator on this vessel
block.aeronautics_innerworld.heat_engine: Produces _32 RPM_ in _mantle lava_. Load _coolant cells_ into a cabin regulator on the same vessel. Stops when cooling is insufficient.
Share coolant through the vessel's cabin regulator. Assemble in mantle lava for 32 RPM. Missing heat or coolant stops power.$(br2)Load coolant before flooding; refill even with power off. Seven engines plus a cabin use 120 units in about 70 seconds.
message.aeronautics_innerworld.core_cons: This console is not connected to a facility circuit.
Use the console empty-handed to check isolation or start the Warden.
